title: Great kettle!
text: Great kettle!. I haven't owned this long enough to see if it holds up over time, but so far I really love it. It heats water FAST and displays the water temperature as it heats, allowing me to guess how much time remains. It would be nice if it had a buzzer or chime when it reaches temperature, but it's not a deal breaker. The pour is slow and smooth, easy to control. I'd definitely buy it again or recommend it to a friend.
